why: One plant per dimension, each a ONE-FIELD mutation of healthy.json. A plant is only ever reported as provocation if (a) its mutation is asserted to have LANDED (the value really changed) and (b) the SAME dimension is still OK on the healthy subject — so a judge that fails everything cannot satisfy the suite.
